sentences.text: This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of bail relating to FIR No.27 of 2023 registered at Police Station - Kotwali, District Ashoknagar (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 363, 366 (A), 354, 506 and 376 (2)(n) of the IPC and Sections 7/8 and 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act.
Allegation against the present applicant is that he committed rape upon the prosecutrix.
Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated.

Entire prosecution story is false which is evident from the fact that the prosecutrix in her statements recorded under Sections 164 and 161 CrPC on 13.1.2023 has not supported the case of the prosecution, however, later on due to pressure of her family members, in her additional statement recorded on 28.4.2023, she made allegation about rape against the present applicant,

sentences.text: 1 however, DNA report is not corroborative.
Further argument is that the applicant is in custody since 01.5.2023.
Investigation is complete and charge-sheet has already been filed, therefore, there is no requirement of further custodial interrogation of the applicant
It is further argued that applicant is the permanent resident of District Ashoknagar (M.P.) and there is no possibility of his absconsion o r tampering with the prosecution evidence.
He has no criminal antecedents.
On these grounds, he prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
Per contra, learned counsel for the State as well as learned counsel for the complainant opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.
Learned
State counsel is directed to send an e-copy of this order to the Station House Officer of the concerned Police Station for information and necessary action.
E- copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance, if possible, by the office of this Court.
Certified copy as per rules.

(SUNITA YADAV) JUDGE AKS Dinesh @ Shiva vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/167865162/
